intent.title: Discover role context from files across all phases

purpose: inspection evidence; not a recovery checkpoint

risks.description: Removing inline content must not omit normative requirements, current findings or exact-byte history. Read selected current fields and inspect retained historical bytes for material provenance questions. Preserve existing record validation and Complete retention; no new storage or migration is introduced.

A provider that logs reads but chooses verdicts by call count proves no source dependence. Discovery controls must derive verdicts from actual linked requirements and current source, retain the stale-version negative, and preserve failed probe evidence. Follow existing repository file conventions under the updated source proposal.

ownership.git_state: Maintained test sources are tracked; temporary outputs remain private and untracked under existing conventions.
ownership.owner_after_creation: Repository maintainers own authored test sources; the creating test runner owns its private outputs.
ownership.owner_during_operation: Maintainers retain source ownership; each runner controls only its own private fixture outputs.
ownership.paths: Maintained test sources under test/ and their private temporary fixture outputs
ownership.permitted_mutation: Reviewed source edits and runner-owned fixture writes/cleanup only; no mutation of unrelated user files or controller evidence.
ownership.upgrade_behavior: Reviewed Git changes update maintained tests; new runs create private outputs; no migration or automatic historical evidence rewrite.
ownership.validation: Existing check plus source-derived lifecycle and negative controls; independent Review assesses the final Candidate.
ownership.when_exists: Edit maintained sources in place within approved scope; preserve preexisting user files and evidence; create private runs without overwriting earlier outputs.

scenarios.evidence: Capture actual provider-boundary prompts for all five routes; fixed metadata small/large sentinel controls; report rendered byte sizes without a new product cap or model-savings claim.
scenarios.given: Fresh Shape, continued Shape, first Developer, resumed Developer and fresh Reviewer run through their production launch paths.
scenarios.then: Each dispatched prompt retains role instructions, authority, configured profiles, output schema and required path/identity locators; task-file bodies, encoded snapshots and serialized verdict/history payloads are absent. Prompt size does not grow with those bodies. The Shaping role covers README and maintained relevant context, directly or through delegated readers; continued Shape preserves identity, original provenance, missing-optional-file behavior and same-conversation approval.
scenarios.when: Task-file and retained historical snapshot bodies grow beyond 1,048,576 characters while paths and execution metadata stay fixed.
scenarios.wrong_result: Only templates are checked, rework still serializes verdicts, or a copied context file/helper packet moves the same bulk payload elsewhere.

scenarios.evidence: Extend existing fake lifecycle harness; change linked requirement or current source in a controlled fixture and demonstrate needs_rework rather than an unconditional accept.
scenarios.given: An Approved package links a normative requirement and the existing tracking record contains attempts, owned receipts and open findings.
scenarios.then: Developer and Reviewer cover the selected complete normative contract and required current record fields through direct or delegated disk reads, bind to the supplied attempt/Candidate, and emit existing schema-valid handoff/verdicts. A verdict depends on the actual linked requirement and current source/evidence bytes. Roots own reading coverage, integration, consequential contradiction resolution and final output without mandatory duplication of helper reads.
scenarios.when: The fake external provider runs in the actual child cwd with path-based task delivery.
scenarios.wrong_result: A provider logs file reads but selects acceptance by call count, uses parent-injected omitted context, or omits requirements absent from the launch prompt.

scenarios.evidence: Real Build driver plus real Stop hook in isolated fixture; invalid handoff, source-derived rejection, repair, fresh Review and publication; inspect record and preserved role-specific snapshot bytes.
scenarios.given: The first handoff is invalid; a later valid handoff reaches fresh Review with a source defect, and retained evidence includes an earlier version of the same file.
scenarios.then: Concise rework gives failure category and existing detail location. Developer selects prior failure and current attempt correctly; fresh Reviewer judges current source and closes every open finding with inspected evidence. Earlier exact snapshots remain available and Complete preserves historical bindings.
scenarios.when: Build resumes the exact Developer within its two-resumption budget and obtains a fresh Review after repair.
scenarios.wrong_result: Rework embeds old verdicts, silently loses findings, judges stale source, changes Developer session or deletes history to shorten prompts.

scenarios.evidence: Retain existing negative lifecycle controls and add discovery-specific missing-path/stale-selection controls; verify no accepted Complete for invalid cases.
scenarios.given: Roles discover authoritative inputs and evidence on disk.
scenarios.then: Existing integrity, contract, gate and publication checks prevent unsupported acceptance. Roles report missing required paths rather than inventing evidence; unfinished optional Shaping files remain permitted. Existing gate ownership, failure classification and attempt limits are preserved.
scenarios.when: Required evidence is absent/unreadable, attempt/Candidate selection is wrong, Approved/Candidate/record bytes mutate, or a verdict supplies invalid references or omits findings.
scenarios.wrong_result: Removing inline context weakens validation, treats claims as gate receipts, silently falls back to old evidence, or rejects an unfinished Draft because optional files are absent.
